extracted_concepts.name: Natürliche Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Positive integers starting from 1, primarily used for counting discrete objects.

extracted_concepts.name: Stellenwertsystem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number representation where the value of a digit depends on its position relative to the decimal point.

extracted_concepts.name: Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental arithmetic operation that combines two or more numbers to produce a sum.

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraktion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental arithmetic operation that finds the difference between two numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiplikation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arithmetic operation representing repeated addition of equal addends.

extracted_concepts.name: Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arithmetic operation that splits a quantity into equal parts or groups.

extracted_concepts.name: Bruch
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical expression representing a part of a whole, written as numerator over denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Dezimalzahl
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number system using a decimal point to separate the integer part from the fractional part.

extracted_concepts.name: Prozentrechnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical method for expressing ratios or proportions as parts per hundred.

extracted_concepts.name: Dreieck
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional polygon defined by three straight edges and three vertices.

extracted_concepts.name: Viereck
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional polygon defined by four straight edges and four vertices.

extracted_concepts.name: Kreis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of all points in a plane that are at a fixed distance from a central point.

extracted_concepts.name: Würfel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Three-dimensional regular polyhedron bounded by six identical square faces.

extracted_concepts.name: Quader
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Three-dimensional solid bounded by six rectangular faces meeting at right angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetrie
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric property where a figure remains invariant under specific transformations like reflection or rotation.

extracted_concepts.name: Länge
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Physical dimension measuring the extent of an object along its longest side.

extracted_concepts.name: Gewicht
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of the gravitational force acting on an object's mass.

extracted_concepts.name: Zeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantitative measurement of duration, intervals, or moments in sequence.

extracted_concepts.name: Hohlmaße
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unit of measurement for the capacity of containers, typically for liquids.

extracted_concepts.name: Balkendiagramm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Data visualization tool using rectangular bars to represent categorical frequencies or values.

extracted_concepts.name: Durchschnitt
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Central tendency calculated by dividing the sum of all data values by the count of values.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value separating the higher half from the lower half of a sorted dataset.

extracted_concepts.name: Ganze Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set comprising natural numbers, their negatives, and zero, excluding fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Rationale Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that can be expressed as the quotient of two integers, where the denominator is non-zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Term
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical expression composed of variables, constants, and arithmetic operators.

extracted_concepts.name: Gleichung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical statement asserting that two expressions are equal in value.

extracted_concepts.name: Lineare Gleichung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving only first-degree terms, typically forming a straight line when plotted.

extracted_concepts.name: Winkel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric figure formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint, measuring rotation between them.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagoreischer Lehrsatz
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental relation in Euclidean geometry stating a² + b² = c² for right-angled triangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Lineare Funktion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function mapping inputs to outputs via a constant rate of change, graphically represented as a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportionalität
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relationship between two variables where their ratio remains constant across all values.

extracted_concepts.name: Zufallsexperiment
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process or trial with multiple possible outcomes, none of which can be predicted with certainty beforehand.

extracted_concepts.name: Wahrscheinlichkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical measure ranging from 0 to 1 indicating the likelihood of a specific event occurring.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistische Kennzahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary metrics derived from data sets to describe distribution, central tendency, or variability.
